reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agent—the Sleeper application itself—as a complex system designed to optimize user experience by batching and caching data. The large byte payloads suggest aggressive pre-fetching strategies. Our primitives must account for this behavior, recognizing that a single page load triggers a cascade of parallel state retrievals, each revealing a different facet of the application's internal knowledge graph.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if the correlation between payload size and data utility breaks down due to heavy minification or binary encoding changes.
